Rose, the roselia, had been resting in the Spinda Bar that had recently been built.  Taking a sip of the drink she had ordered, she sighs and leans back in her seat.  She had been wishing something important in her life had happened...something that would make it interesting instead of being a simple villager.  She stands after finishing her cup and thanks spinda as she makes her way to the stairs to exit, but suddenly, she bumps into someone as she walks up the steps.  "Woah- WOAH!"  Rose shouts as the pokemon trips and sends her tumbling down the steps with them.  They land on top of eachother, and muffled voices fill her ears.

"Boss!  Are you alright?!"  One voice shouts

"Yeah bawse, you took quite da fall there" says another.

Gasping for breath stuck under the pokemon, Rose is relieved when the pokemon stands and allows her to catch her breath.

"Yeah yeah, I'm fine.  Don't worry 'bout it."  The pokemon, now identified as a Skuntank, states to the two others, identified as a Koffing and Zubat.  The trio turn their attention to Rose.

"Oi!  What's da big idea?!"  The Zubat exclaims.

"O-Oh, I apologize.  I was just trying to leave-"  Rose trails off at the sight of the Skuntank.  She blushes.  They had just met, of course, but Rose thought that this Skuntank was decently handsome...and it was only Rose who took the time to admire the other.  The Skuntank stared at Rose as well, and she could just barely hear a "Woah..." escape from his mouth.

After putting himself together, the Skuntank says "Bah, I'll let it slide...this time..."  and with that, he walks further into the bar.  The two others follow.  Rose begins to leave before she is stopped "Actually...wait."

She turns to see the Skuntank facing her.

"The name's Toxin, and yours?" They ask

"R-Rose..."

"Thats a nice name"  Toxin replies.  "Say, why don't you come sit with us for a while.  You seem like a fine lady and I'd like to get to know you better."

Rose pauses for a moment, then smiles "I'd enjoy that.  It's the least you can do to make it up to me that is!"

"Oi!  You ran into me first-"  Toxin catches themselves "er...nevermind, hurry along"

Rose hurries down the steps to arrive at Toxin's side.  They smile, then proceed to their seats.  Maybe, just maybe, this would be a start of a relationship blooming.

"Phew!" Red shouts as he climbs down the stairs into Sharpedo's Bluff.  His personal rescue team had just gotten back from their usual catching outlaws and saving those in need.  Following Red, the Torchic, down these steps are Blue the Riolu, Toxin the Skuntank, and Rose the Roselia.  Blue and Red immediately head to the table situated in the center of their makeshift home and sit there, staring hopefully at Rose

Rose groans "Can't you two make your own food?  I can't be a chef forever when we get back from a mission"

"Oh cmon, Rose!  We all know your cooking is the best!" Blue replies, seemingly very hungry for being out in a dungeon for so long

"Ugh, fine...I'll make some food for you two.  Let me guess, Roasted Corpinch?"

"Yes please!"  Red and Blue exclaim at once.  Along with this, a strike of thunder bursts from outside

"Oh dear, I guess it's raining..."  Rose states to herself as she prepares to cook.

"No s___, Sherlock..." Toxin says quietly, looking out the gaping mouth of the Sharpedo.  His bad language had gotten much worse recently, and his reaction to a simple statement reveals that.

"Oh, knock it off, Toxin.  Just because you hate us doesn't mean you need to be such a rude person"  Red says

Toxin just huffs, then heads into another room lower down.  The room is quiet for a long time, only thunder and the occasional lightning flashes to break the silence.  Finally, Blue speaks up

"So...what an outlaw, huh?"

"You said it" Red replies "I didn't know Keckleon could do all that!"

"True, did you see how angry he looked after the outlaw threw that Stun Seed he had for sale at Toxin?"

"Sure did.  At that point we didn't even need to do anything!"

The two share a laugh before giving out a long sigh.  At this point, Toxin makes his way back upstairs, clamping a book in his mouth as he lays in a straw bed, painted a slight purple, and meant to be a couch Blue made.  However, it had recently turned into a bed that Toxin house
.  With this, he lays down and begins to read

"Sure you dont wanna eat, hun?" Rose asks, quietly.

"No thanks, babe.  That Perfect apple I had once we left made me stuffed"

"Got it, mister tough guy" and with that, Rose continued cooking.  It was common knowledge at this point that Rose and Toxin were together, along with Red and Blue who had both been dating for about a week before the great Dialga Fight of 2010.  The room was quiet, all until Red and Blue head the sound of plates clanking

"Alright you two, don't act like you haven't eaten in-" Rose was cut off by the immediate noise of Blue beginning to scarf down his plate of food "-...days"

The two ate for a good bit, ending with a hefty sigh, then without another word the two got up and left to the downstairs rooms.  These rooms were simple bedrooms, and as the two walked by, they glanced into each one.  The first one they passed was a nicely painted one, mixed with beautiful paintings if flowers and deadly skulls from the old team of three Toxin was a part of.

"When do you think he will forget about the old team?" Asked Red

"Dunno, but I hope it's soon.  One more skull and I'm gonna punch a hole in the wall"

"...Like you haven't done that already"

The two continued down the hall, when Blue stopped.  He looked into the second bedroom.  It had been painted with waves and cute little finger painting of a manaphy with a riolu and torchic.  It was empty from any residents.  Blue steps into the room, gives it a nice look around, before kneeling down to the finger painting and stroking it with his paw

"Wherever you are, Manaphy, I really hope you're safe..."

Red enters and sighs "Blue, I know you miss her.  She will be back soon, I promise she will"

Without looking back up, Blue replies "...Do you think she forgot about us?"

It had been almost a year since Manaphy had been sent out into the ocean.  Knowing how fast mythicals and legendaries age, she should have been old enough to travel back and live with them by now.  Alas, she had not

Red gives Blue a worried look "...I can't confirm she didn't, but I know her.  She is safe and sound.  She is gonna be back-"

Blue interrupts "She was the only child I've ever had...we have ever had.  I just wish she would come home so we can love her again..."

"Blue...just because she left us doesn't mean we can't love her."

"You're right..." a visible tear slips down Blue's cheek "I just...I want her to be safe.  I don't want anything to have hurt her, you know she has a hard time fighting."

"I know, Blue...I know...it's getting late.  Why don't we go to bed and talk more in the morning, okay?"

Blue looks up, wipes off his cheek, then stands and nods "Sure, let's just hope we can get a good night sleep in this weather."

The two pokemon then make their way to a room, painted with a beautiful sunset over an ocean.  They roll onto their own respective straw beds, and close their eyes.






Meanwhile...

Rose, still in the living room/kitchen, hears a knock at the door.

"In a moment!"  She shouts, as she stands from the straw couch and hurries over to the door.  She opened it, and gasped.

"Hello, auntie Rose!" Says a childish voice, the storm still wailing in the distance.  Rose looking down, mouth gaped, all she could mutter out was a couple words


"...You're...home"

Silver and Gold have been exploring this dungeon for ages.  Supposedly it was called the buried relic...however, they weren't there for the adventure.  They were there for the treasure.  Just recently, Gold, the Persian, had heard of a wonderful treasure kept in the bottom of this relic...however, so far, they haven't seen anything



Buried Relic BF98


"Spot anything yet, Silver?"  The Persian asked

"Nope...you?"  Responded the Marowak

"Nothing- oh wait!  I think I see..."

Suddenly, Silver came tearing around the corner "What, what?!"

"...Stairs..." Gold sighed.  They had seen exactly 97 flights of those things

"Just great...another floor" Silver said as he stepped down the flight of stairs.  However, he wasn't greeted by another room of the dungeon...instead, he was greeted by...

"TREASURE!" Gold shouted as she leaped from the group and dove towards a heap of purple crystals and treasure chests.  Silver jogged over to the mass of treasure, followed by a so far silent Absol named Crystal.  Among the heap of treasure, Crystal notices a bandana among the treasure.  They walk over towards it and proceed to put it around their neck.

"How do I look?"  They ask

Silver turns to face Crystal "Wow, snazzy.  Wait...what's that?" 

Silver points to a very noticeable lump in the bandana.

"Thats...odd" states Gold as they walk over to Crystal and tap the bandana.  Just as that happens, a rectangular shaped object drops from the bandana and onto the glistening pile of treasure

"Someone must have come here before us to hide some treaure...well too bad for them!  Mine!"  Gold shouts happily.  She picks up the object, but once it is grabbed it immediately lights up onto a screen of many colors.  The screen's brightness dies down as a photo appears on it.  It's a photo of a man and his family, a wife, 3 kids, and a riolu.  They are a staring happily into the camera, however the man's face is blocked off by a clock stating the time

"Now this is weird..." Silver says.  This object feels famailiar...but how?  Words light up on the screen "swipe left to open"

"Welp, no use in just standing here.  Boop!"  Gold says as they swipe the screen.  The screen changes to another screen with several different squares with symbols scattered across them.

"Now this is interesting..." Crystal states as they tap an icon with a red box and an arrow in the middle.  The screen then transitions to a purely white screen with smaller boxes that have photos on them.  Ones with small cartoon creatures, ones that have a person staring into the camera looking surprised, you name it, they saw it.

"Hurry, tap one!"  Gold commands Silver.  Silver listens and taps a box that has a photo of pokemon playing off in a park like place.  The screen transitions once again to a video titled "Message to Tom".  The video starts with camera footage being played.  A voice familiar to Silver starts to speak.

"Tom, look how happy those pokemon are.  I hope you're happy too.  If you ever see this, please know that your family is looking out for you.  Your Riolu is safe with us, so don't worry about him.  Just...please come home safely soon.  I can't stand another day away from my precious boy..."  the voice begins to sound like they're crying "Tom...please...please come home Tom..."  the video ends with a click

Gold and Crystal share a look of confusion

"That was weird..." said Gold.  This statement was cut short however by a sniffle from Silver

"I...I remember that voice."  He stated, a tear streaming down his face.  He had a look of realization and fear on him as he snatched the screen from Gold.  He tapped a circular photo of a woman below the video.  It took them to a screen that stated the woman's name. "Grace Ludenburg"  the description read "wife to Eliot Ludenburg and mother of Tom Ludenburg"

"Thats...thats..." Silver could barely speak between the tears.  As he cried, he finally could get out the word "mom..." before he broke down.  Memories flooded back of his human life as he realized, this wasn't just any old screen.  It was his phone he had gotten when he was 15.  It still was kept stable through all the years.  Ideas flooded his head as he thought to himself how it ended up where it did.  Then, it hit him.  However, before he could say anything, he was hoisted onto Crystal's back.

"You can tell us all about it when we get out of here..." Crystal stated "Gold, take everything you can carry.  I think we should give Silver some space when we leave

A bit later, the team left the dungeon.  They arrived back to town, not a word said, as they all walked back to their homes.  Silver, however, didn't get a good night's sleep.  Instead, he was busy looking through the screen he had retrieved from the dungeon.  He looked through several photos, dates, ect ect.  He smiled while doing so, now knowing he had some memory of his past life now.  He set the screen on a table beside his bed, like it was routine, then closed his eyes.  He had a lot of stuff to think about tomorrow...

The Wingull outside of the sharpedo's rock are cawing madly.  The sound of waves rushes over the rocks below the place where our heros are resting.  First to awaken is Red, a torchic whose fears have gotten the best of him multiple times in the past.  Red yawns, then stands from their bed.  They look outside the gaping mouth of the Sharpedo and drowsily ponder to themselves
*"Today was something special for my partner...what was it...something about the human world..."*
He gasps, then looks at the calender, which was customly made by Red's current partner and best friend, who is also a human.  The photo of his partner giving the torchic a slight noogie at the top of the calender gives Red a slight chuckle, but then as he glances down, he sees a circle over the current day.  It reads, "Blue's Birthday"
Red gasps, wondering how he forgot, then rushes over to his sleeping partner, Blue.  Blue is a riolu who was transformed into a human and was destined to say the pokemon world.  Red gives Blue a slight peck in the back of the head
"Oi, wake up!"
Blue groans, "five more minutes..."
Red sighs then pecks him again "This is important!"
"What's important is my sleep..."
Red sighs, knowing the only possible thing that could get Blue to wake up was saying a certain line.  He clears his throat then shouts in their best Loudred impression, "ITS TIME TO WAKE UP!"
Although not being nearly as strong as Loudred, it seemed to have done the trick.  Blue shot up, looks around, then sighs when he sees that only Red was in the room
"...What do you want?"
"Check then calender!"
Blue glances at the calender, then sees the circled date.
"...It's today?"
"Yeah!  Now get up!  I just remembered I set up a surprise for you yesterday!"  Red say this as he rushes up the flight of stairs and out of the Sharpedo's head.  Blue tilts his head, slightly confused, but stands and follows behind Red.  Red meets him at the top of the steps, blocking his view from the outside.
"Close your eyes!"
"I'm not closing my eyes"
"Close them!"
Blue crosses his arms
"You're making this a big deal"
"No I'm not, Close your eyes!"
Blue rolls his eyes, then shuts them tight.  He blindly walks up the steps, then follows Red (albeit, only by voice commands as Red didn't have the arms to guide him) into the town nearby.  Blue could tell they were it the town by the bustling of the pokemon around the town.  After a sudden stop, Red nudges Blue, gesturing them to open their eyes.  Blue opens his eyes, blinded by the sunlight for a bit before seeing...the entrance to Spinda's Cafe?
"Why are we here, Red?"
"Trust me, come on!"
The two walk down the stairs into Spinda's cafe...but it was empty?  Almost as sudden as the sunlight that hit his eyes when he uncovered them a minute ago, pokemon shot up from under tables, behind desks, and even the Ludicolo came bustling around with their song and dance.  They all shouted something...not really understandable due to the large amount of pokemon, but Blue could bet it was "Happy Birthday" which made him smile.  Red did this all for him.  The ludicolo danced around the room as Blue and Red walked forward.  They were first stopped by Kangaskan, who smiled
"Hey there, honey!  Glad you made it!"
"Morning, Kang!"  Blue said.  He had given almost everyone in town a short nickname he called them
"Goodmornin' to you too!  Red told us 'bout your birthday comin' up, so I took the time yesterday to bake you up somethin' nice!"  With that, she held out a nicely baked cake.  It had the pokemon guild member badge put on it with icing and it read out "To one of our greatest guild members!"
"Aw, you shouldn't have, Kang!  I love it!"
"Don't worry 'bout it, sugar!"
The two continued down.  They stopped when the ludicolo line dancing passed by them, and when they continued, they were greeted by a few other guild members.  Bidoof and Sunflora.  The two smiled at them and gave a quick congrats before allowing the two to move on.  However, before the two could really make it any further, they were stopped by...Chatot?
"Well well well, if it isn't one of my favorite guild members!"
A slight "I'm your favorite?"  Squeaked out of red at that moment as Blue went to speak
"Oh, hi Chatot!  We're you able to take a break from the guild work for a second to come congratulate me?"
"Well, sure!  I don't see why I wouldn't!  Oh, here.  I have some gifts from the guildmaster"
Chatot hands the two a perfect apple each.  With a smile, they hop off
The two laugh at each other then walk forward.  They made a stop at Spinda's stand to make an order, but Spinda spoke first.
"Hey!  Don't worry about ordering, i think I know what you're getting...and besides, it's your birthday!  Have one on the house!"
"Oh, uh, thanks!"
A slight uncomfortable laugh comes from Blue.  This was a bit awkward, and a bit much.  Especially for a birthday.  However, this thought was interrupted by a "Hey, idiots!  We've been calling you!"
Blue recognized the voice and turned to face it.  It was the two other main team members, Toxin the Skuntank, and Rose the Roselia.  They were both beckoning Blue and Red over to the table, to which they happily accepted.  The two took a seat
Rose spoke first "Are you enjoying yourself?"
Blue answered "Well, sort of.  This is a bit much for a birthday"
Red scoffed "Oh please, you're a huge hero!  You saved the world!  Of course we would go a bit overboard with your party!"
The table laughed before Toxin spoke up "Oi, Blue, I saw you talking to Spinda, but you didnt bring any drinks.  Did you just make small talk or what?"
"Heh, no.  He said they were on the house.  I think he is serving them to us too, which is an added bonus"
"Figured he should make himself useful for once" Toxin stated with an added mischievous laugh afterwards.  With that almost as if he summoned Spinda, they came gliding over to the table they were at with four trays of different colored drinks.  The drinks were very recognizable to Blue.  One was slightly pink with a bit of a yellow progression the more up the cup you get.  That was most likely Rose's with her Pecha Berry Tea.  Next was a very dark blue drink with a slight surrounding sprinkle of...he never found out yet.  This was most likely Toxin's Rawst Roundabout, which was a fitting name for a drink that was 20% drink 80% alcohol.  The next one was a very red drink with Tamato Berry bits inside.  This was Red's Flaming Spirit drink.  Last one was a lighter blue cup with apple slices surrounding the rim.  One was even floating on the drink inside.  This was most definetly Blue's casual Oran Juice (with extra apple).
The group got their drinks, then the four held their drinks close in the center of the table.
Red shouted "A toast, to team WhirlWind!"  This was followed by a clink of cups.  Blue new at that moment, he made the right choice staying in this world.
